locations.title: Neptuna
locations.description: **Solution:** ||Let Neptuna approach and then dash out of the way. After their attack, swim close and tail swipe. Repeat this three times. Beware after the second hit, they will shoot electric balls that you need to avoid.||

locations.title: Cactus Jack
locations.description: **Solution:** ||Avoid his projectile spine attack and whirlwind. Wait for him to be dazed after his whirlwind attack then jump and tail swipe him. Repeat this three times.||
